title: Agent telemetry: Claude Code and Codex

panels.title: User prompts
panels.description: Prompts typed by you (or sent by -p/SDK). One prompt triggers many API calls and tool calls.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="user_prompt" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | decision="reject"[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Reject rate
panels.description: Rejected tool decisions / all tool decisions.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | decision="reject"[$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__range]))

panels.title: Cost (USD)
panels.description: Estimated from API pricing; plan limits are metered differently. Source: cost_usd on api_request events (Loki), an estimate from list prices, not billing. The Prometheus cost counter was not used because concurrent processes shared one series and overcounted about 14x.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_error" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Tool latency p95 by tool
panels.description: tool_result.duration_ms. Includes execution only; time spent waiting on you is not in here.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (tool_name)

panels.title: API request latency p50 / p95 by model
panels.description: api_request.duration_ms: full model response time, includes output generation. Compare with the output-tokens panel before blaming a model.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (model)
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (model)

panels.title: Where tool time goes (total seconds by tool)
panels.description: Sum of tool durations. Optimise the top entries first: p95 shows spikes, this shows what actually costs wall-clock.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))) / 1000

panels.title: Where model time goes (total seconds by model)

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))) / 1000

panels.title: Tool latency summary (calls, avg ms, p95 ms, failures)

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__range]))
avg by (tool_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (tool_name)
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | success="false"[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Slowest single tool calls (max ms by tool)
panels.description: Outliers: hung commands, slow MCP servers, big reads.

targets.expr: max_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (tool_name)

panels.title: MCP server connect time
panels.description: Startup cost of MCP servers; failures show as status != connected.

targets.expr: max_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="mcp_server_connection" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (transport_type, status)
sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__auto]))

panels.title: Cost by model (USD)
panels.description: Source: cost_usd on api_request events (Loki), an estimate from list prices, not billing. The Prometheus cost counter was not used because concurrent processes shared one series and overcounted about 14x.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap cost_usd [$__auto]))

panels.title: Tokens by model and type
panels.description: Source: token fields on api_request events (Loki). The Prometheus token counter was not used because concurrent processes shared one series and overcounted.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap input_tokens [$__auto]))
sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap output_tokens [$__auto]))
sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__auto]))
sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__auto]))

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by model
panels.description: cache_read / (cache_read + cache_creation + uncached input). Low values mean cold caches (idle gaps, model switches) and slower, costlier turns.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__auto])) / (sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__auto])) + sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__auto])) + sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap input_tokens [$__auto])))

panels.title: Output tokens per second by model
panels.description: Throughput proxy. Includes time-to-first-token, so short outputs look slow.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap output_tokens [$__auto])) / (sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto])) / 1000)

panels.title: Effort level mix (requests)
panels.description: Higher effort costs latency; check it matches the task.

targets.expr: sum by (effort) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__auto]))

panels.title: Tool decisions by outcome and source
panels.description: source: config = allow/deny rule matched, user_temporary / user_permanent = you were asked, hook = a hook decided. Anything that is not config costs you an interruption.

targets.expr: sum by (decision, source) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__auto]))

panels.title: Rejected, by tool and source (why blocked)
panels.description: Each bar is a tool that was refused and who refused it. config rejects mean a deny rule or a missing allow rule in non-interactive mode.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (tool_name, source) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | decision="reject"[$__range])))

panels.title: Permissions you were asked for (by tool)
panels.description: Candidates for an allow rule in settings: frequent, always accepted, low risk.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | source=~"user.*"[$__range])))

panels.title: Interruptions: accepted by hand, by tool
panels.description: user_temporary = allow once (asked again next time); user_permanent = saved rule. Many user_temporary on one tool = add a rule.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (tool_name, source) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | decision="accept" | source=~"user.*"[$__range])))
sum by (permission_mode) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__auto]))

panels.title: Your input: how often and how heavy

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="user_prompt" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__auto]))

panels.title: Avg prompt length (chars)
panels.description: Content is never exported (prompt text is redacted). Very short prompts after a tool run usually mean approvals or nudges.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="user_prompt" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap prompt_length [$__auto]))

panels.title: Tool calls per user prompt
panels.description: High = the agent runs long unattended (good). Low and flat = you steer every step.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__auto])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="user_prompt" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__auto]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | success="false"[$__auto]))

panels.title: API errors by status
panels.description: 429/529 = rate limits or overload; retries add latency to every turn.

targets.expr: sum by (status_code, error_type) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_error" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session"[$__auto]))
sum by (host_name) (increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{host_name=~"$host", session_id=~"$session"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Skills used (selected range)
panels.description: Needs OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 on the client; without it tool_parameters is absent and this stays empty. Counts every Skill tool decision (accepted and rejected). Only sessions started with the flag are counted.

targets.expr: sum by (skill_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | tool_name="Skill" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json skill_name="skill_name" [$__range]))

panels.title: Skill invocations over time
panels.description: Needs OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 on the client; without it tool_parameters is absent and this stays empty. Counts every Skill tool decision (accepted and rejected). Only sessions started with the flag are counted.

targets.expr: sum by (skill_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_decision" | tool_name="Skill" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json skill_name="skill_name" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Prompts by session
panels.description: User prompts per session in the selected range. Needs OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID=true on the client; sessions started before that carry no session_id and are not listed.

targets.expr: sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="user_prompt" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | session_id!=""[$__range]))

panels.title: Tool calls by session
panels.description: Tool results per session in the selected range. Needs OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID=true on the client; sessions started before that carry no session_id and are not listed.

targets.expr: sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | session_id!=""[$__range]))

panels.title: Cost by session (USD)
panels.description: Cost per session in the selected range. Needs OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID=true on the client; sessions started before that carry no session_id and are not listed. Source: cost_usd on api_request events (Loki), an estimate from list prices, not billing. The Prometheus cost counter was not used because concurrent processes shared one series and overcounted about 14x.

targets.expr: sum by (session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | session_id=~"$session" | session_id!="" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Codex (api_request, user_prompt, startup verified live; tool_result and tool_decision panels stay empty until a logged-in run)
Codex tool latency p95 by tool
panels.description: If empty after a real run: Explore Loki labels for service_name starting with codex, then fix event_name and the duration field.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.tool_result" | host_name=~"$host" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (tool_name)

panels.title: Codex API request latency p95 by model

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (model)
sum by (decision, source) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.tool_decision" | host_name=~"$host"[$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.user_prompt" | host_name=~"$host"[$__auto]))

panels.title: Codex API errors by message
panels.description: e.g. http 401 = not logged in, 429 = rate limit.

targets.expr: sum by (error_message) (count_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.api_request" | host_name=~"$host" | error_message != ""[$__auto]))
max_over_time({service_name=~"codex.*"} | event_name="codex.startup_phase" | host_name=~"$host" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto]) by (startup_phase)
